tools.name: get_started
tools.title: Start here
tools.summary: Start here. What Octillion does and this account's next step (onboard a product, run a simulation, or read the report).

tools.name: onboard_product
tools.title: Onboard a product
tools.summary: Start here. Describe a developer tool with a short prompt plus its website and docs links.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.title: Onboarding progress
tools.summary: Progress and output of a product onboarding: research stage, the generated product profile, developer personas, programming problems and the simulation it launched.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.summary: List the organization's products with scenario counts and their 30-day recommendation hit rate.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Product context
tools.summary: Show a product's configured context (description, aliases, package names, domains, competitors), its scenarios with per-scenario hit rate, and recent simulations.

tools.name: save_product
tools.title: Create or update product
tools.summary: Create a product, or update one when `product` names an existing one.

tools.name: save_scenarios
tools.title: Add or edit scenarios
tools.summary: Add scenarios (omit id) or edit existing ones (pass id).

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.title: Run simulation
tools.summary: Launch sandboxed coding sub-agents on the product's scenarios.

tools.name: list_simulations
tools.title: List simulations
tools.summary: Recent simulations with progress and hit rate.

tools.name: get_simulation
tools.title: Simulation results
tools.summary: One simulation: progress, verdict counts, hit rate by model, a scenario x model matrix and every agent session.

tools.name: cancel_simulation
tools.title: Cancel simulation
tools.summary: Cancel a simulation: queued sessions never start, and running sessions are stopped (their model access is revoked and their sandboxes shut down).

tools.name: get_visibility_report
tools.title: Visibility report
tools.summary: A sectioned report on whether coding agents pick the product: headline findings; results by platform (web, mobile, backend, ...) and by task (built on the product, on which competitor, or on no…

tools.name: export_visibility_report
tools.title: Export pick rate report
tools.summary: Export the Pick rate report (the portal's Pick rate page): pick rate, its 95% interval, times picked, competitor share, pick rate by agent, harness, model, task, persona and platform, head-to-head,…

tools.name: get_agent_session
tools.title: Agent session
tools.summary: One sub-agent session: scenario, model, status, cost, verdict, the tool it went with and the transcript evidence for every product it mentioned.

tools.name: get_session_transcript
tools.title: Session transcript
tools.summary: Read a sub-agent session's raw JSONL transcript (messages, tool calls, commands, results), a page at a time.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.title: Search transcripts
tools.summary: Full-text search across this organization's agent transcripts.

tools.name: list_developer_profiles
tools.title: Developer profiles
tools.summary: Curated developer personas (role, experience, company size, stack, constraints) from the vault, plus your organization's own.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: Worker agents
tools.summary: A developer population's coding-agent mix: the agents Octillion simulates (harness, model, pinned version) and each one's share, in whole sandboxes out of 20, from real-world developer usage with…

tools.name: save_personas
tools.title: Save private personas
tools.summary: Add or update your own developer personas (the developers you target).

tools.name: list_personas
tools.title: Private personas
tools.summary: Your organization's own personas: the ones you saved and the ones research picked for your products.

tools.name: import_tasks
tools.title: Import a private task set
tools.summary: Bring your own tasks (for example from past case studies) as a named task set for a product.

tools.name: list_task_sets
tools.title: Private task sets
tools.summary: Your organization's private task sets and their tasks.

tools.name: publish_to_library
tools.title: Publish to Octillion's library
tools.summary: Offer one of your own personas (persona: slug from list_personas) or one task of your own task sets (task_id from list_task_sets) to Octillion's shared library.

tools.name: register_harness
tools.title: Register a private harness
tools.summary: Submit your own coding agent as a declarative spec (pinned packages with integrity hashes, the executable and its arguments, the model providers it calls through the Octillion gateway).

tools.name: review_draft_tasks
tools.title: Review draft tasks
tools.summary: Approve or reject the draft tasks onboarding research proposed for needs Octillion's task library does not cover (listed by get_onboarding).

tools.name: save_harness_mix
tools.title: Save a private harness mix
tools.summary: Define your own distribution of coding agents (for example only the agents your users run), from the runnable agents in list_agents.

tools.name: list_harness_mixes
tools.title: Private harness mixes
tools.summary: Your organization's own harness mixes.

tools.name: list_harnesses
tools.title: Private harnesses
tools.summary: Your organization's private harnesses and their review status.

tools.name: browse_task_library
tools.title: Task library
tools.summary: Browse the curated library of real-world developer tasks (active ones: id, title, prompt, platform, category, language, repo, tags).

tools.name: save_to_memory
tools.title: Save to memory
tools.summary: Save one lasting item to the account's institutional memory: a fact, decision, preference or note about the company, the signed-in person ('me') or a product.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.title: Search memory
tools.summary: Search the account's institutional memory: the company's items, this person's own and product items, newest first.

prompts.name: onboard_product
prompts.summary: Research a developer tool from its website and docs, build its profile, personas and problems, and start a coding-agent run.

prompts.name: visibility_report
prompts.summary: A full written report on whether coding agents pick the product, why, and what to change: sectioned like a case study, backed by session evidence.

prompts.name: explain_loss
prompts.summary: Read one agent session's evidence and explain why the coding agent chose a competitor.

prompts.name: compare_models
prompts.summary: Compare how each coding agent and model treats the product.

prompts.name: weekly_digest
prompts.summary: A short weekly digest across all products: movement, notable losses, runs and actions.
